name: Grand Hyatt Baha Mar
positioning: Resort on Cable Beach at the center of the Baha Mar complex, with The Reserve as a hotel-within-a-hotel
best_for: Families wanting a waterpark, a kids' club and wildlife encounters
Travelers who want golf, a spa and a casino in one resort

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Baha Mar is set on Cable Beach and is the most central of the hotels in the Baha Mar complex.
Grand Hyatt was the first hotel to open in the Baha Mar complex.
All guest rooms, suites and villas have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the ocean, the island or the fountain show.
All room categories include balconies, ranging from Juliet balconies to fully furnished ones.
The Reserve's VIP Lounge serves breakfast each morning, light refreshments through the day and hors d'oeuvres in the evening.
Butler service is available with the two-bedroom residences in the East Tower and the two-bedroom poolside villas.
Each of the resort's pools has its own distinct Bahamian design, with daybeds, in-pool chaises and cabanas.
ESPA at Baha Mar is a 30,000-square-foot spa.
Royal Blue at Baha Mar is a Jack Nicklaus Signature Golf Course, with ocean vistas on the front nine and forested panoramas on the back nine.
Baha Mar Casino has 100,000 square feet of gaming and live entertainment.
Chef Marcus Samuelsson's Marcus at Baha Mar Fish + Chop House is on the beachfront near the pier.

highlights.text: The Reserve is a hotel-within-a-hotel on the top floors of the East Tower, with a private VIP entrance.
Flamingos, sea turtles and tropical birds are part of the resort's wildlife experiences, and there is a daily flamingo parade.
Baha Mar resort guests have unlimited access to Baha Bay waterpark, set directly adjacent on 15 beachfront acres.
The ESPA spa is perched above the beach.
The Chairman Suite has four bedrooms and a private pool overlooking ocean and island views.

considerations.text: This is a large resort and is less intimate than smaller hotels.
Dining and spa reservations should be planned ahead because prime slots fill quickly.
The resort is about five miles from downtown Nassau.
